 The USC Trojans College Football Playoff Hopes and quarterback Jayden Maiava's draft stock hinge on the second half of the season.  USC Trojans USC quarterback Jayden Maiava trotted onto the field in front of a record breaking crowd of 114,419 people at Penn State in week 6. 
--> USC quarterback Jayden Maiava trotted onto the field in front of a record breaking crowd of 114,419 people at Penn State in week 6. 
 The song “Mo Bamba” by Sheck Wes blasted throughout the stadium for the annual White Out game at Beaver Stadium. 
--> The song “Mo Bamba” by Sheck Wes blasted throughout the stadium for the annual White Out game at Beaver Stadium. 
 Oct 10, 2026; University Park, Pennsylvania, USA; Southern California Trojans quarterback Jayden Maiava (14) throws a pass during a warmup prior to the game against the Penn State Nittany Lions at West Shore Home Field at Beaver Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Matthew O'Haren-Imagn Images | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect The USC quarterback silenced the rocking crowd on the first play of the game with a 12-yard completion to Zacharyus Williams. He proceeded to go a perfect 5-of-5 on the drive and connected with freshman receiver Trent Mosley for a 19-yard touchdown. 
--> The USC quarterback silenced the rocking crowd on the first play of the game with a 12-yard completion to Zacharyus Williams. He proceeded to go a perfect 5-of-5 on the drive and connected with freshman receiver Trent Mosley for a 19-yard touchdown. 
 The entire drive, Maiava displayed a calmness to him. He wasn’t fazed by the environment. He wasn’t going to allow the crowd to affect him pre-snap, and he certainly wasn’t going to let it affect him during the play. 
--> The entire drive, Maiava displayed a calmness to him. He wasn’t fazed by the environment. He wasn’t going to allow the crowd to affect him pre-snap, and he certainly wasn’t going to let it affect him during the play. 
 Throughout the night, Maiava made plays that left one of college football’s most hostile environments silent. You could hear a pen drop as the Trojans signal-caller delivered from start to finish.
--> Throughout the night, Maiava made plays that left one of college football’s most hostile environments silent. You could hear a pen drop as the Trojans signal-caller delivered from start to finish.
 Maiava completed 21-of-33 passes for 301 yards and three touchdowns. For a quarterback that has started close to 40 career games and is in year three under coach Lincoln Riley, it was the type of performance you would expect in that situation and can elevate a team in tough games. 
--> Maiava completed 21-of-33 passes for 301 yards and three touchdowns. For a quarterback that has started close to 40 career games and is in year three under coach Lincoln Riley, it was the type of performance you would expect in that situation and can elevate a team in tough games.

Mandatory Credit: Matthew O'Haren-Imagn Images | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect “Thought he was poised, confident. I think he was very locked into how we wanted to attack them and I thought he stayed really steady throughout the entire game,” Riley said. “He played how you need your senior quarterback to play and one of your experienced players in terms of that environment. 
--> “Thought he was poised, confident. I think he was very locked into how we wanted to attack them and I thought he stayed really steady throughout the entire game,” Riley said. “He played how you need your senior quarterback to play and one of your experienced players in terms of that environment. 
 “I thought he handled it well. He played one of his best games for certain. Just really proud of his poise. There was just king of a calmness with him and there was energy but he was just very calm throughout the entire game.”
--> “I thought he handled it well. He played one of his best games for certain. Just really proud of his poise. There was just king of a calmness with him and there was energy but he was just very calm throughout the entire game.”
 It’s not Maiava's best game statistically. He threw for a career-high five touchdowns against Louisiana in week 2. The week prior against Fresno State, Maiava competed 92% of his passes and three touchdowns. 
--> It’s not Maiava's best game statistically. He threw for a career-high five touchdowns against Louisiana in week 2. The week prior against Fresno State, Maiava competed 92% of his passes and three touchdowns. 
 But given the atmosphere and stakes, it was arguably the best performance of Maiava's career in the Cardinal and Gold. 
--> But given the atmosphere and stakes, it was arguably the best performance of Maiava's career in the Cardinal and Gold. 
 Path Forward for Jayden Maiava 
--> Path Forward for Jayden Maiava 
 Oct 3, 2026; Los Angeles, California, USA; USC Trojans quarterback Jayden Maiava (14) passes the ball against the Washington Huskies during the second quarter at United Airlines Field at Los Angeles Memorial Coliseum. Mandatory Credit: Griffin Hooper-Imagn Images | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect ESPN’s Mel Kiper recently released his player and position rankings for the 2027 NFL Draft. Seven quarterbacks landed in the top 50 and Maiava wasn't one of them.
--> ESPN’s Mel Kiper recently released his player and position rankings for the 2027 NFL Draft. Seven quarterbacks landed in the top 50 and Maiava wasn't one of them.
 Is Maiava the most disrespected quarterback in the country? Perhaps. There’s definitely a strong argument. He's constantly overlooked when talking about the top quarterbacks in the country and in discussions around the 2027 draft.
--> Is Maiava the most disrespected quarterback in the country? Perhaps. There’s definitely a strong argument. He's constantly overlooked when talking about the top quarterbacks in the country and in discussions around the 2027 draft.
 But it’s only October. The draft doesn’t happen until April of 2027. And this isn’t the offseason where a player can see their draft stock skyrocket in shorts and a t-shirt. There’s still a lot of games still left to be played. 
--> But it’s only October. The draft doesn’t happen until April of 2027. And this isn’t the offseason where a player can see their draft stock skyrocket in shorts and a t-shirt. There’s still a lot of games still left to be played. 
 Consistency is the big thing for Maiava. Stringing together performances like the one he had in Happy Valley is vital because the week before against Washington, Maiava played his worst game of the season. 
--> Consistency is the big thing for Maiava. Stringing together performances like the one he had in Happy Valley is vital because the week before against Washington, Maiava played his worst game of the season. 
 The Trojans have a tough road ahead with road games against Wisconsin, Indiana and UCLA. Ohio State rolls into town on Halloween. Each game is an opportunity for Maiava to make a statement that would not only put his team in position to make a run at the College Football Playoff but elevate his draft stock.
--> The Trojans have a tough road ahead with road games against Wisconsin, Indiana and UCLA. Ohio State rolls into town on Halloween. Each game is an opportunity for Maiava to make a statement that would not only put his team in position to make a run at the College Football Playoff but elevate his draft stock.
 Playing the way he did against Penn State on the road against Indiana and UCLA would catch the attention of NFL decision makers. Shining inside the Coliseum against Ohio State at the end of the month would be hard to ignore. 
--> Playing the way he did against Penn State on the road against Indiana and UCLA would catch the attention of NFL decision makers. Shining inside the Coliseum against Ohio State at the end of the month would be hard to ignore. 
 Southern Cal needs more out of defense in those upcoming ranked matchups but the outcomes will largely fall on the shoulders of Maiava. The biggest advantage USC could have in those games is the play of Maiava and that has been the case since the redshirt senior took over as the starter in November of 2024. 
--> Southern Cal needs more out of defense in those upcoming ranked matchups but the outcomes will largely fall on the shoulders of Maiava. The biggest advantage USC could have in those games is the play of Maiava and that has been the case since the redshirt senior took over as the starter in November of 2024. 
 The Trojans are 11-0 in games where Maiava doesn’t throw an interception. They are 14-1 when it completes more than 61-percent of his passes. 
--> The Trojans are 11-0 in games where Maiava doesn’t throw an interception. They are 14-1 when it completes more than 61-percent of his passes. 
 Maiava is the unquestioned leader of the team. USC will go as far as he takes him.
